recipes.title: Oreo Blizzard Protein Shake

items.i: sugar-free vanilla pudding mix or sweetener
scoops vanilla ice cream whey protein (e.g. Optimum Nutrition)

steps: Add the ice, milk, vanilla, pudding mix or sweetener, protein powder and Oreos to a blender and blend until thick and smooth.
Pour into a tall cup, top with whipped cream and crushed Oreo.
recipes.notes: 350 calories and 50 g protein are as stated; the full recipe was only in the creator's TikTok caption, so amounts, carbs and fat are estimated from what's shown.
